name: xinhe-salary-audit-agent
description: Evidence-first salary cross-check for China: screens images for manipulation risk, extracts tax/bank/social-insurance/housing-fund figures, reconciles month by month, flags year-end bonus tax thresholds and rehired-retiree cases, and produces a versioned HTML report with coverage and confidence.

displayDescription.en: Verifies salary evidence before trusting it: image tamper screening, field extraction, monthly reconciliation, and a versioned report with coverage and confidence.
displayDescription.zh: 先验图、再取数、后勾稽：逐月核对个税/银行/社保/公积金，偏差分级，报告带版本与溯源。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Here are a candidate's tax, bank and social-insurance screenshots. Verify the salary and tell me what does not add up.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是候选人的个税、银行流水和社保截图，帮我核一下薪资，看看哪里对不上。

quickPrompts.en: Verify this candidate's salary from these screenshots and flag anything that does not add up.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据这些截图核一下候选人的薪资，把对不上的地方标出来。

quickPrompts.en: Check whether these payslip images look edited before using their numbers.
quickPrompts.zh: 先用之前先看看这些工资截图有没有被改过的痕迹。

quickPrompts.en: I added two more months of statements — update the report without rerunning everything.
quickPrompts.zh: 我又补了两个月的流水，之前的不用重跑，更新一下最终报告。
